events.verdict: Turner (IND) establishes himself in Williamson's (NOP) path and absorbs the contact to his upper body as he sets the pick.
Alvarado (NOP) and Turner (IND) come together at the same spot in the lane, and the off-ball contact is marginal.
Turner (IND) is in the lane for longer than three seconds.
Turner (IND) establishes himself in Alvarado's (NOP) path and is firming up when contact occurs.
Turner (IND) legally contests Hawkins' (NOP) driving shot attempt and absorbs the contact to his upper body.
Sheppard (IND) establishes himself in Williamson's (NOP) path and absorbs the contact to his upper body.
Williamson (NOP) legally contests Haliburton's (IND) jump shot attempt.
Mathurin (IND) cleanly dislodges the ball from Williamson (NOP) at the end of his drive.
Turner (IND) brings his hand towards Missi's (NOP) left arm, and the contact that occurs as he removes his left hand from the ball is marginal.
Missi (NOP) releases the ball prior to the expiration of the 24-second shot clock.

Ingram (IND) brings his hand forward and initiates contact with Mathurin's (IND) upper body as he defends the driving shot attempt.  The contact occurs as Mathurin is cupping the ball in his right hand to gather, and a shooting foul is correctly whistled.
Siakam (IND) commits a take foul on Williamson (NOP).
Toppin (IND ) commits a take foul on Hawkins (NOP). The transition take foul rule does not apply to the last two minutes of either the fourth quarter or overtime.
Alvarado (NOP) reaches in and initiates contact with Haliburton's (IND) upper body that occurs prior to Alvarado's gather.
Alvarado (NOP) and Sheppard (IND) come together at the same spot, and incidental foot to foot contact occurs off-ball.
Toppin (IND) commits a take foul on Hawkins (NOP).
Ingram (NOP) maintains verticality and legally contests Mathurin's (IND) shot attempt near the basket.
Williamson (NOP) gathers the ball on his left foot and takes two steps before the take foul is committed.
